title: (2025 DEC) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: This post lists cumulative updates released for Business Central versions 27, 26, and 25, along with links to historical updates for older versions. Latest updates should be installed as some fix security vulnerabilities.
key_points: Update 27.2 released for v27 (2025 Release Wave 1)
Update 26.8 released for v26 (2025 Release Wave 1)
Update 25.14 released for v25 (2024 Release Wave 2)
Updates include hotfixes for all countries and localized versions
Versions 24 and older no longer receive updates

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why staying current with updates is critical for security and system stability.
